brand.name: Rohan Shinde Photography & Films
brand.description: International award-winning wedding photography and filmmaking company based in Mumbai, India. We specialize in capturing timeless stories through candid, traditional, and cinematic artistry across India and global destinations.

statement.title: Timeless Visual Storytelling
statement.quote: We approach wedding filmmaking with the intent of making something timeless, something that carries your story across generations. We try to capture reality in the most beautiful way possible, versus modifying realities to make them fit manufactured narratives. Couples who choose us, understand and trust this, and here are the films and frames we have to show for it.

testimonials.quote: Choosing Rohan and his team was the best decision we made for our Goa wedding. They felt like family, completely unobtrusive yet never missed a single emotional beat. When we saw our wedding film, everyone—including my grandparents—was in happy tears.
Rohan's eye for light and genuine human expression is unmatched. Our photos don't look like posed stock wedding shots; they feel alive, breathing with the real energy of our Gujarati celebration.

From our pre-wedding shoot at Sets in the City to our grand reception at Athena Banquets, the films were cinematic perfection. Crisp 4K audio, flawless color grading, and stories that will outlive us all.

faq.q: What is your approach and visual style?
faq.a: We are documentary candid storytellers at heart with a strong editorial eye. We believe reality is far more captivating than staged theatrics. We capture real laughter, spontaneous tears, and quiet glances while providing gentle direction during couple portraits.

faq.q: Do you travel for destination weddings?
faq.a: Yes! Over 60% of our weddings are destination events across Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa, Kerala, Lonavala, Mussoorie, as well as international destinations including Bali, Italy, and Thailand. Travel and stay are arranged in coordination with the couple.

faq.q: How soon do we receive our photos and films?
faq.a: You receive a curated 40-50 photo teaser and an Instagram video teaser within 72 hours of the event so you can celebrate online immediately. The full color-graded photo set is delivered in 4-6 weeks, and the master 4K wedding films within 8-10 weeks.

faq.q: How do we book and secure our wedding dates?
faq.a: We accept a strictly limited number of weddings per year (max 25) to preserve our craft and personalized attention. A 50% advance retainer and signed service contract secures your dates on our calendar.
